answer_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE
  p.list_price > 1000

sections.title: What it says its rows are

body.value: One figure, read off the single row the query returned: 44,657,111.19 USD (44,657,111.18659 exactly) — what Contoso actually charged customers, after discount, for every sale of a high-value product over the whole ten years of orders in this bundle, 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31. High-value means the product's own catalogue price is above 1,000 USD: 154 of the 2,517 products, every one of which sold at least once, across 7,644 order lines. Walk-in shops and the web shop are both counted — 26,302,947.79 and 18,354,163.40, which add to the figure. NOT IN IT: the 2,837,417.62 of discount given away on these sales (at list they would have been 47,494,528.81 gross); the 4 products priced at exactly 1,000.00, worth 565,656.00, excluded by the question's ">"; products that pass 1,000 only on a per-sale price, which would make the answer 73,012,890.34 on unit_price or 69,924,368.11 on net_price; and no deduction for returns or credits, because this bundle records none.

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.list_price > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_above_1000,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.list_price > 1000 THEN p.product_key END) AS products_above_1000_that_sold,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.list_price > 1000 THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_above_1000,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.list_price > 1000 THEN s.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue_above_1000,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.list_price = 1000 THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_exactly_1000,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN p.list_price > 1000 AND s.channel = 'physical'
      THEN s.net_amount
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS net_physical,
  SUM(
    CASE WHEN p.list_price > 1000 AND s.channel = 'online' THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END
  ) AS net_online,
  MIN(CASE WHEN p.list_price > 1000 THEN s.order_date END) AS first_order_date,
  MAX(CASE WHEN p.list_price > 1000 THEN s.order_date END) AS last_order_date
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE
  p.list_price >= 1000
